scope: Multipart session controls only; no presigned URLs, binary proxy, queue publisher, worker or HTTP endpoints.

implementation.module: StorageModule exports STORAGE symbol using useExisting S3StorageService. StoragePort and StorageError contain no SDK/HTTP types. Client is destroyed on module shutdown. Consumer imports will be introduced by their own SIs.
implementation.pagination: ListParts follows authoritative NextPartNumberMarker, limits pages to 1000 and part numbers to 10000; rejects missing/nonadvancing markers and invalid size/ETag/order. Integration overrides page size to 1 and uploads two real parts.
implementation.metadata: Server part sizes/ETags preserved; completion sends exact part ETags and reads authoritative object ContentLength/ETag using HeadObject in the same bounded operation.
implementation.configuration: Internal configured endpoint, region, credentials, forcePathStyle and explicit WHEN_REQUIRED request/response checksums; maxAttempts=2; one AbortController deadline of 30000ms per operation including all pages/head.
implementation.errors: Typed upload_not_found, object_not_found, invalid_multipart, unavailable, operation_failed and invalid_response. Missing bucket/access denied are not mistaken for missing object. Errors propagate with fixed sanitized messages; no credential or SDK diagnostic logging.
implementation.transport: Native and foreign-realm name/code guards plus exact Smithy error-wrapper prefix with known transport codes. Installed @smithy/core/dist-cjs/submodules/retry/index.js asSdkError was inspected: stringified foreign-realm native errors lose cause/code. Unknown wrapper stays operation_failed.
implementation.repeated_completion: Real MinIO replay is recoverable by successful repeat or typed missing session followed by HeadObject of server-owned immutable key; adapter never treats arbitrary existing objects as proof of this session.

acceptance_proofs: Real two-part multipart upload (5242880 + 20 bytes), ListParts with page size 1, complete and GetObject. Actual received length and SHA-256 match concatenated original bytes.
Real completion repetition and authoritative object reconciliation.
Real abort makes ListParts return upload_not_found and further UploadPart with same id return NoSuchUpload; no completed object exists.
Real invalid ETag rejects completion as invalid_multipart and leaves object absent.
Real connection refusal to Docker service minio port 1 is unavailable, while actual absent key is object_not_found.
Unit request deadline aborts a pending SDK operation; failures, malformed pagination and cross-realm errors are propagated and sanitized.

test_fix_history.diagnosis: Recursive Jest comparison of 5 MiB exceeded per-test deadline; replaced with exact length + SHA256. Added structural native error guards, but SDK had already stringified that foreign-realm error.
Inspected Smithy asSdkError and matched its precise wrapper + known transport codes. Added positive/negative unit coverage. All 30 focused tests then passed. Temporary diagnostic logging removed.

documentation.version_note: Context7 branch/main snippets were cross-checked against installed SDK 3.1152.0 types and real MinIO execution.

development_database.state: Existing development DB container started temporarily for read-only pg_dump hash, then stopped to restore prior state. No migrations or writes applied.

limitations: 5 MiB multipart fixture proves session controls and byte integrity; it is not the later 10 GB/memory acceptance proof.
Signing, bounded file transfers and user-facing recovery orchestration remain in their planned SIs.
Development HTTP server and video worker were not started.
